about: RH2 demand and the vendor reference decide the gateway operations. Local queue and phones are private simulation bookkeeping, not vendor account resources.

decisions.demand: RH2 away notifier; vendor single-message and multi-recipient examples
decisions.why: Expand recipients, preserve ticket order, reject over 100 notifications and mixed projects; queue accepted payloads for the simulated providers.

decisions.demand: Vendor published receipt lookup and error examples; the customer investigates delivery failures as recommended by the reference
decisions.why: Return available provider receipts keyed by ticket id; omit unknown, pending and expired ids; refuse over 1000 ids.

decisions.demand: the World's own door, POST /_twin/devices: { project, platform, owner? }: an app installs on a phone and registers for pushes; answers its Expo push token
decisions.why: { project, platform, owner? }: an app installs on a phone and registers for pushes; answers its Expo push token, which no vendor API makes.

decisions.demand: the World's own door, POST /_twin/devices/{token}/uninstall: the app is uninstalled: the token no longer reaches a device
decisions.why: The app is uninstalled: the token no longer reaches a device, which no vendor API makes.

decisions.demand: the World's own door, GET /_twin/devices/{token}/notifications: what the phone was shown, newest first
decisions.why: What the phone was shown, newest first, which no vendor API makes.
